Definition: Consent, rapport, interviewer questions, prompts, summaries and back-channel responses (e.g. "okay", "yes") without substantive content.
Include / Exclude: Exclude any participant statement with substantive content, even if short.

Definition: Administration of the six K6 items and participants' frequency answers.
Include / Exclude: Descriptive only; not interpreted thematically or diagnostically. Elaborations that go beyond a frequency answer receive a substantive code as well.

Definition: Interviewer turns that state the researcher's own assumptions, suggest an answer, or frame the topic in a way that may shape the reply.
Include / Exclude: Used as an audit flag for memos; never counted as participant evidence.

Definition: Descriptions of occupations, trades, land, businesses or household work in Syria.
Include / Exclude: Include accounts of not working in Syria. Exclude meanings attached to work (PAST-STATUS).

English label: Work as status, respect and self-worth in Syria
Arabic label: العمل كمصدر مكانة واحترام في سوريا
Definition: Meanings of past work: reputation, social standing, independence, feeling of being someone.
Include / Exclude: Requires an evaluative or meaning statement, not only a job description.

Definition: Loss of home, property, savings, livelihood, relatives or place caused by war and flight.
Responsibility for supporting household members, school fees, food, rent.
Include / Exclude: Include expectations of oneself as provider.

Definition: Changes in who provides or decides: dependence on children, widowhood, wife or children working, role reversal.
Include / Exclude: Must describe change compared with before.

Definition: Norms that restrict or enable women's or men's work, mobility or roles.

English label: Work and livelihood activity in Jordan
Definition: Any paid, informal, home-based, seasonal or project work in Jordan, and attempts to find it.
Short contracts, dismissal, low or unpaid wages, exploitation, long hours, unsafe or irregular work.
Cash or food assistance, UNHCR/WFP support, aid cuts or exclusion from aid.

English label: Age as a barrier / ageist treatment
Definition: Age limits in programs or jobs, employers preferring the young, ageist remarks.
Include / Exclude: Exclude accounts in which participant denies age discrimination (NEG-AGE).

English label: Health as a barrier to work
Definition: Physical illness, pain, disability, fatigue that limits work.
Include / Exclude: Health without link to work goes to HEALTH.

Definition: Work permits, camp exit, ownership/registration restrictions, documentation.

English label: Lack of capital and market constraints
Definition: No money for a project, debt, rising prices, competition, weak markets.
Caring for children or ill relatives limits work.
Program criteria, closures, lack of funding, short or basic courses, no tools after training.
Include / Exclude: Age criteria in programs are coded BAR-AGE as well.

English label: Age not experienced as a barrier
Definition: Participant states that age did not cause exclusion or that ability, not age, matters.
Skills, crafts, qualifications and competencies participants hold.
Statements linking work or own income with dignity, self-respect, independence, not needing others.
Shame or hurt of asking, owing, being dependent, being seen as a burden.

English label: Changed regard from family or community
Definition: Perceived drop or change in respect, treatment or view linked to money or status.
Participant states that family or community regard has not changed.
Self-described worry, tension, sadness, boredom, despair, crying, sleeplessness.

English label: Distress at lost productivity / feeling useless
Arabic label: الضيق بسبب فقدان الإنتاجية والشعور بعدم الجدوى
Definition: Distress explicitly tied to not working or not producing as before.

English label: Work and activity as relief and meaning
Definition: Work, crafts or activity described as relieving, occupying the mind, giving purpose.
Staying home, avoiding people, loneliness, reduced social contact.
Chronic illness, medication, treatment costs, ageing body.

English label: Daily routine and use of time
Definition: How participants spend their days; empty time.
Not knowing whether to stay or return; living without a plan.
Reliance on God, prayer, patience, acceptance.
Children, spouse or relatives as meaning, motivation or support.
Determination, adaptability, learning, refusing to give up.
Neighbours, friends, community help, belonging, Jordanian hosts.
Gossip, mistrust, conflict, discrimination by community (non-age).
Teaching, guiding, advising, helping others, feeling socially useful.
Desire for training, guidance, capital, tools, job placement.
Scepticism that training or programs would help.
Hoped-for projects, housing, roles for oneself.
Hopes, conditions, fears or ambivalence about return.
Belief that people of their age have experience/role in rebuilding.

English label: Doubt about generation's role in rebuilding
Arabic label: التشكيك في دور الجيل في الإعمار
Definition: Statements that their generation has little or no role, or that rebuilding depends on others.

English label: Rights claims and messages to decision-makers
Definition: Messages to organisations/governments about older refugees' rights and needs.
